title: Make latest task result and error copyable
context: TasksScreen shows the latest execution result or error as selectable text, but provides no direct copy action for sharing or troubleshooting.
goal: Let users copy the exact latest execution result or error with one tap without changing execution state or implying verification.
forbidden_changes: Do not change KernelSession or runtime execution semantics.
Do not add persistence, telemetry, or network calls.
Do not claim copied content proves task completion or verification.
acceptance_criteria: A visible copy action copies the exact latest result when a result is displayed.
A visible copy action copies the exact original error when an error is displayed.
Copy action labels are localized in English and Vietnamese.
The change remains limited to the Tasks screen and its localization strings.
verification: Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA workflow
Review the diff for exact result/error copy behavior
recovery: Revert the single task commit if the Apple build fails or copy actions alter runtime behavior.
